name: Ricardo Benavídez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport security began unexpectedly. A former military police officer with a decade of service in Buenos Aires, Ricardo was drawn to the high-stakes environment of racing after providing security for a local rally event. He quickly recognized the parallels between managing crowd control and ensuring the safety of personnel and assets in a motorsport setting.

Though relatively new to the specific nuances of motorsport security, Ricardo brings a methodical approach and a keen eye for detail honed through his military background. He is focused on implementing robust security protocols and preventative measures to minimize risks. Ricardo is driven by a desire to establish a safe and secure environment where teams can focus on pushing the boundaries of performance without compromising safety.

Ricardo is known for his unwavering commitment to protocol and his ability to quickly assess and respond to potential threats. He believes in empowering his team through clear communication and rigorous training, ensuring they are prepared for any situation.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed military cut with slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a powerfully built man with a stern expression and an unwavering gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook to document observations.
Insists on double-checking every security measure, even if it was already verified.
Has a habit of speaking in military jargon, even when unnecessary.
